issues.message: 16 % detail blocks: on the bare side, aim for 20 %+.
stone_bricks is 56 % of the build: break it up with a second material.

notes.detail: L1 is a bare stone shell: footing, corbels, two recessed slits; fine for a first level of a wall module but little small detail.
notes.depth: Front has footing, corbels and slits; the inner (back, z2) face is a flat 5-high slab of brick with only cobble patches.
notes.roof: Crenellated parapet on corbels, stepping up at x2. Joins otherwise match: left end (x0) = straight profile (walk stand y5, parapet y5, merlon y6 at x0); right end (x4) = straight profile +1 (stand y6, parapet y6, merlon y7 at x4); the stair at x2 y5 z1-z2 faces east, so the walk climbs the right way.
notes.materials: Stone bricks, cobble, mossy cobble: right for a wall.
notes.shape: Parapet and walk step up 1 at x2: a good silhouette.

visual.summary: Level 1 stepped stone wall module: like the straight piece, but the walk climbs one block via a stair at x2 and the parapet steps up with it.
problems: Corbel course does not step with the parapet: corbels (upside-down stone_brick_stairs) run at y4 z0 across x0-x4, so at x2-x4 the raised parapet is 2 courses tall (y5+y6) above them, while the raised straight piece that joins at the right end has its corbels at y5. The corbel line jumps at the right-hand join instead of with the parapet at x2. Fix: put the corbels at x2-x4 on y5 z0 (stone_brick_stairs facing=south, half=top) and make y4 z0 x2-x4 air, so the right end matches the straight profile raised by 1 everywhere.

issues.message: 72 blocks, over the module budget of 60 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

notes.artefacts: Last round's corbel problem is fixed: corbels x2-x4 now at y5 z0 with air at y4, stepping with the parapet.
notes.roof: Half merlon x0 y6, crenel x1, raised parapet y6 x2-4 with merlons x2/x4 at y7.
notes.shape: The step gives the piece a second height.

visual.summary: Level 1 stepped wall module: the straight profile on the left half, rising 1 block from x2 via a stair (x2 z1-2 y5) with parapet and corbels stepping up with it.
problems: Corbel fix confirmed: right end (x4) now equals the straight profile raised by 1 (corbel y5, parapet y6, merlon y7, walk floor y5); left end (x0) equals straight exactly, and so joins corner v2. OK.
